2228-4279-4616.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-4616.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-4616.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

4279-7316-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-7316-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1329-3363-8095.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

512-4137-7014.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-4137-7014.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

141-2511-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-2511-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

394-856-5776-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
394-856-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1363-1636-4336.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying its mana cost.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Kobolds of Kher Keep and one other creature you control, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-4336.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

703-4924-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {4}{U}{U} due to Heartless Summoning.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat from step 2.
703-4924-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

321-399-2475-4985-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2645-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had six nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2060-2645-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding six mana of any color(s).
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

659-1995-4050.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Gauntlets of Light attached to Krenko.
659-1995-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
659-1995-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

5670-6273-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6273-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1550-3480-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-3480-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1887-3484-4365-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1887-3484-4365-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1355-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two enchantments.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1355-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

333-2511-2730.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2511-2730.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1621-3122.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Undercover Operative.
1621-3122.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Undercover Operative enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Undercover Operative. Choose to have Undercover Operative enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1754-2511-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-2511-4766-5683.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4359.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

542-1031-1367.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nexus of Fate from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Repeat each turn.

803-2292-4338.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1486-1680-3459-4461.notablePrerequisites:
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
Runed Stalactite attached to Battered Golem.
1486-1680-3459-4461.description:
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Battered Golem ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

905-5075-5097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a black creature onto the battlefield under your control.
905-5075-5097.description:
Put a black creature onto the battlefield under your control.
Shadow Alley Denizen triggers, targeting any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1877-2822.notablePrerequisites:
Kediss does not have summoning sickness.
Kediss is one of your commanders.
You have the highest life total among all players.
An opponent is unable to block Kediss.
1877-2822.description:
Declare Kediss as an attacker, choosing to attack an opponent unable to block.
Before damage, cast Hatred targeting Kediss and pay life equal to the highest life toal among your opponent.
Kediss kills the defending player.
Kediss triggers, dealing lethal damage to each other opponent.
